exampleAnswers.title: Writing an Upper Riemann Sum for a Strictly Increasing Function

question.text:
Let $R = [-1,4] \times [3,6]$ be a region in the $xy$-plane, and let $f(x,y) = 4x + 7y - 16.$ Further, let $P$ be a partition of $R,$ where

\begin{align*} P_1 = \left\{x_0,x_1,\ldots, x_m\right\}, \qquad P_2 = \left\{y_0,y_1,\ldots, y_n\right\}, \qquad P = P_1\times P_2. \end{align*}

Given that the upper Riemann sum of $f$ with respect to $P$ is given by \[ U(f,P) = \sum_{i=1}^m\sum_{j=1}^n \fbox{$\phantom{AAAAA}$} \: \Delta x_i \Delta y_j \] where $\Delta x_i = x_{i} - x_{i-1}$ and $\Delta y_j = y_{j} - y_{j-1},$ what is the missing expression in the double summation above?
question.explanation:
The upper Riemann sum is given by \begin{align*} U(f,P) &= \sum_{i=1}^m\sum_{j=1}^n M_{ij}\Delta x_i \Delta y_j \end{align*} where $M_{ij}$ is the maximum value of $f$ in each subregion $R_{ij}.$

We consider an arbitrary subregion $R_{ij}$ of the partition. This subregion lies between $x_{i-1}$ and $x_i$ over the $x$-axis and $y_{i-1}$ and $y_i$ over the $y$-axis, as shown below.

Notice that:

  • $f(x,y) = 4x + 7y - 16$ increases as $x$ increases, and

  • $f(x,y) = 4x + 7y - 16$ increases as $y$ increases.

As a result, the maximum value of $f$ in each subregion is attained when we have the largest possible $x$ and the largest possible $y.$ This is the value at the top right corner of each subregion.

Therefore,

\begin{align*} M_{ij} & = f(x_{i}, y_{j}) = 4x_{i} + 7y_{j} - 16 \end{align*} for all $1\leq i\leq m$ and $1\leq j\leq n.$

Finally, the upper Riemann sum is \begin{align*} U(f,P) &= \sum_{i=1}^m\sum_{j=1}^n ({\color{blue}{4x_{i} + 7y_{j} - 16}})\Delta x_i \Delta y_j. \end{align*}

So, the missing expression is $4x_{i} + 7y_{j} - 16.$

\begin{align*} P_1 = \left\{x_0,x_1,\ldots, x_m\right\}, \qquad P_2 = \left\{y_0,y_1,\ldots, y_n\right\}, \qquad P = P_1\times P_2. \end{align*}

Given that the upper Riemann sum of $f$ with respect to $P$ is given by \[ U(f,P) = \sum_{i=1}^m\sum_{j=1}^n \fbox{$\phantom{AAAAA}$} \: \Delta x_i \Delta y_j \]

where $\Delta x_i = x_{i} - x_{i-1}$ and $\Delta y_j = y_{j} - y_{j-1},$ what is the missing expression in the double summation above?
question.explanation:
The upper Riemann sum is given by \begin{align*} U(f,P) &= \sum_{i=1}^m\sum_{j=1}^n M_{ij}\Delta x_i \Delta y_j \end{align*} where $M_{ij}$ is the maximum value of $f$ in each subregion $R_{ij}.$

We consider an arbitrary subregion $R_{ij}$ of the partition. This subregion lies between $x_{i-1}$ and $x_i$ over the $x$-axis and $y_{i-1}$ and $y_i$ over the $y$-axis, as shown below.

Notice that:

  • $f(x,y) = 8y-2x-5$ decreases as $x$ increases, and

  • $f(x,y) = 8y-2x-5$ increases as $y$ increases.

As a result, the maximum value of $f$ in each subregion is attained when we have the smallest possible $x$ and the largest possible $y.$ This is the value at the top left corner of each subregion.

Therefore,

\begin{align*} M_{ij} & = f(x_{i-1}, y_{j}) = 8y_{j} - 2x_{i-1} - 5 \end{align*} for all $1\leq i\leq m$ and $1\leq j\leq n.$

Finally, the upper Riemann sum is \begin{align*} U(f, P) &= \sum_{i=1}^m\sum_{j=1}^n ({\color{blue} 8y_{j} - 2x_{i-1} - 5 })\Delta x_i \Delta y_j. \end{align*}

So, the missing expression is $8y_{j} - 2x_{i-1} - 5.$
